slot.The summer of 1914 was one: You'd never have guessed what was coming.
slot.For the young British soldiers of 1914: You'd watch the white cliffs fade behind you.
slot.The relief takes place at night: You'd be glad to see the dugout at last.
slot.With the tea, there might be bacon: You'd remember that smell for the rest of your life.
slot.At home in Britain, in December 1914: You'd want to send something, too, if you could.
slot.Behind the lines, in the villages: You'd hear carols coming from the little church.
slot.Christmas Eve in the trenches: You'd feel the night grow very still.
